This is a remote position, all candidates must be able to work within the United States. Company Overview:
BIM Technology Management (BIMTM) has spent years building an all-star team of BIM (Building Information Modeling) professionals to drive innovation in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry.

Our mission is to revolutionize project delivery through advanced BIM technology and seamless collaboration, empowering contractors, engineers, and designers across all MEP disciplines. We are currently seeking a talented BIM Specialist to join our dynamic team and contribute to our ongoing success.

In this role, the BIM MEP Specialist plays a pivotal part in leveraging BIM technology to connect professionals across the AEC industry. Working closely with project teams, your expertise will be instrumental in optimizing virtual design and construction (VDC) workflows, ensuring coordinated models, and enhancing overall project efficiency. You’ll also help define and uphold BIM standards and processes within the MEP scope.

Lead the seamless integration of MEP systems into BIM models, ensuring data accuracy and clash-free coordination.
Oversee the coordination of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems with other trades and disciplines.
Model and coordinate MEP systems, collaborating with subcontractors to ensure accurate representation and prefabrication-ready outputs.
Utilize experience in modeling, coordination, and spooling for prefabrication processes across various MEP components.
Develop and enforce MEP-specific BIM standards, protocols, and best practices.
Manage the creation and maintenance of MEP BIM models for accuracy and constructability.
Deliver training and mentorship on MEP BIM/VDC workflows and standards.
Stay informed on emerging BIM software and tools that impact MEP modeling and coordination.
Foster collaboration between BIM, field, and project management teams to ensure clear communication and efficient project delivery.
Analyze BIM data and reporting metrics to identify performance trends and improvement opportunities.
Review MEP models for completeness and compliance with established standards.
Produce detailed construction documentation from MEP models per industry and project specifications.
Continuously improve workflows and tools to support model quality and efficiency.
Effectively prioritize and manage deadlines while proactively addressing potential delays.

Proficiency in MEP-related BIM tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, Fabrication CADmep).
Strong experience in BIM coordination workflows across multiple MEP trades.
Familiarity with prefabrication detailing and spooling processes.
Evolve MEP experience is a plus.
Strong critical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to mentor and train others in MEP BIM tools and workflows.
Detail-oriented with a focus on high-quality deliverables.
Knowledge of sustainable building practices and industry certifications is a plus.
Experience collaborating with field, shop, and project stakeholders.

As a BIM Specialist at BIMTM, you’ll be a key contributor in shaping the future of BIM technology in the MEP space. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment where your voice matters and your expertise drives results. If you're passionate about MEP coordination and thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first culture, we’d love to hear from you.

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada ’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.
With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.
Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada ’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

Armada is hiring a Senior Data Center BIM Designer to support the Galleon, Leviathan, and Orion product lines — a brand-new capability for the company.

As we scale Modular Data Center (MDC) deployments across a growing number of sites and geographies, we need someone who can own the BIM thread that ties every discipline together — civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, piping, controls, and ICT — into a single coordinated model and build the BIM and drawing standards infrastructure.
You will build and own Armada 's fully integrated BIM model spanning CSA, MEP, controls, ICT, produce and govern drawing packages for containerized and modular form factors (ISO shipping containers, e-houses, and skid-mounted equipment with PEMB buildings), and set the drawing libraries, standard details, templates, title blocks, and naming conventions the rest of the design team will build on.

This is a facility-level BIM role — you'll build and coordinate the full data center model and drawings rather than modeling individual equipment from scratch, incorporating 3D models supplied by equipment manufacturers and vendors into the facility model.

You'll also be the senior technical authority and cross-discipline escalation point, working directly with product and engineering leadership to embed repeatable, scalable BIM practices into new product development (Galleon/Leviathan/Orion) from day one.
Location. This role is remote-based on the continental US (approximately 10–20% travel to project sites, fabrication facilities, and vendor/GC locations).

Integrated, all-discipline BIM ownership — Build and maintain one coordinated Revit/BIM model covering civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, piping, controls, and ICT for both the existing Modular Data Center (MDC) product line and new product development (Galleon/Leviathan/Orion), so the whole data center lives in one model instead of different disciplines working in isolation.
BIM/drawing standards from the ground up — Build and own the drawing libraries, standard details, templates, Revit families, title blocks, and naming/layer conventions for CSA and MEP alike — the framework the rest of the design team will work within going forward.
Senior technical authority on containerized and prefab drawing packages — Own how new form factors — ISO shipping containers, e-houses, skid-mounted equipment with PEMB buildings — get modeled and documented end to end across all MDC disciplines, setting the pattern the rest of the team follows.
Cross-discipline coordination — Run clash detection/coordination across all MDC disciplines, review design output against standards and the master model, and act as the single escalation point when disciplines conflict.
Repeatable, scalable design for new product development — Work directly with product/engineering leadership to define modular BIM templates and campus-level design patterns across the full discipline set as new products are developed — shaping how Galleon/Leviathan scales, not just documenting decisions made elsewhere.

7+ years of hands-on BIM/CAD design and drafting experience in commercial, industrial, or modular/offshore projects — with deep, hands-on experience in either CSA (civil, structural, architectural) or MEP (mechanical, electrical, piping) and strong working knowledge of the other, plus demonstrated ability to coordinate across both.
Strong proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD, with demonstrated ability to build and manage multi-discipline models and run clash detection/coordination (Navisworks or equivalent).
Ability to build BIM/drawing standards, libraries, templates, title blocks, and naming/layer conventions.
Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy — you'll be defining the playbook, not inheriting one.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 10–20% to project sites, fabrication facilities, and vendor/GC locations worldwide.

Prior experience with containerized, modular/prefabricated, or skid-mounted data center drawing packages — ISO shipping containers, e-houses, or skid-mounted equipment with PEMB or existing/new buildings.
Experience integrating controls/BMS and ICT (structured cabling, low voltage, fire alarm, security) scope into a single coordinated BIM model.
Experience standing up design standards, templates, or governance processes for a growing team, rather than only executing against existing ones.
Background collaborating directly with product/hardware engineering teams on new product development, not just project-based site work.
Autodesk Certified Professional (BIM Management for Building Design or discipline-specific Revit).
Experience administering a CDE (Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360), familiarity with ISO 19650/openBIM standards, and reality capture (ReCap) for as-built verification.
4D/5D BIM capability — experience linking models to project schedules (4D, e.g., Navisworks TimeLiner or Synchro) and cost/quantity takeoffs (5D, e.g., Assemble Systems), to support sequencing and cost forecasting for repeatable MDC deployments.

Samen met je collega’s bedenk je nieuwe, innovatieve branchespecifieke oplossingen of producten. Je ontwikkelt jezelf continu in de software en wordt steeds opnieuw uitgedaagd.
Uiteindelijk ben je verantwoordelijk voor BIM-implementaties en begeleiding van de klant in het optimaal gebruiken en toepassen van BIM en de bijbehorende software. Het is jouw missie om de meeste waarde uit de software en projecten te halen passende bij de werkzaamheden van de klant. Dit zijn onder andere architecten, aannemers, installateurs, CAD-tekenaars, bouwkundig tekenaars en constructeurs.
Wie zoeken wij?
Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding bouwkunde of installatietechniek.
Twee tot vijf jaar werkervaring bij een aannemer of installatiebedrijf.
Enige ervaring met Revit- en andere CAD-toepassingen.
Je kunt goed plannen, organiseren en samenwerken.
Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden.
Je bent creatief.
Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs.
Beschikbaarheid tussen de 36 en 40 uur per week.
Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.
Wat bieden wij?
Auto van de zaak;
30 vakantiedagen;
Gratis lunch op kantoor;
Collectieve pensioenregeling;
Passend salaris bij jouw werkervaring;
Winstdelingsregeling afhankelijk van je prestaties tot 3 maandsalarissen;
Jaarlijks opleidingsbudget;
Hybride werken;
Verschillende personeelsactiviteiten, waaronder maandelijkse kennisbijeenkomsten “LunaTICS”, gezamenlijke lunches, workshops, wekelijkse bootcamp en personeelsuitjes.
Wij zijn NTI CAD & Company. Met onze coaching halen onze klanten het maximale resultaat uit hun ontwerp. Wij ondersteunen en begeleiden implementatieprocessen, innovatie- en digitaliseringstrajecten, bieden trainingen door gecertificeerde trainers en delen onze kennis over nieuwe technologieën. Dit doen we op basis van o.a.

Autodesk ontwerpsoftware en Microsoft-software. Onze klanten bevinden zich in de bouw, civiele techniek & infra, installatietechniek en industrie. Wij helpen bedrijven digitaliseren. Bijvoorbeeld met het aansluiten bij BIM, van 2D naar 3D bewegen, nog meer uit 3D-modellen halen en het inzetten van datamanagement.
